description: Per-residue sub-pocket fingerprint diversity (3D-aware local-patch complement to global Tanimoto IntDiv1). Mean pairwise Tanimoto distance on Morgan-ECFP4 fingerprints aggregated over per-residue 8.0 A neighbourhood (Bemis-Murcko 1996 + Peter 2019 SPF).
scope: Lambda + CFM evaluations (uniform-weight default for Lambda-only path; voxelization.py:208/255 or vina_adapter.py:961 for weighted pocket version)
math_prior: div_residue_i = mean_{m in pocket} rigid_rmsd(mol_m, ref_mol) for mol_m within 8.0 A of residue_i C-alpha; aggregate: per_residue_div = mean_i div_residue_i; bounded [0, 1.0] Tanimoto distance; 0.0 on N<=1 or empty pocket (graceful degenerate)

aggregate.lit_target_targetdiff: TargetDiff does NOT report per-residue; closest analog is per-pocket ligand-COM distance — TargetDiff M2 mismatch flagged in TODO-22

verdict: DESIGN_ONLY — Phase-3D module + Phase-4 dispatch integration shipped; full pilot smoke at Round-12 10x3 not yet executed (per workflow #666). Honest framing: this metric is wired and unit-tested but production 100-pocket Round-13 sweep is BLOCKED pending F2(a) MetalLigandExchange SMARTS rule (TODO-29).

defect_1_uniform_placeholder_weights.why_it_matters: A uniform weight vector is indifferent to which residue a Morgan bit belongs to, so the sub-pocket axis the metric name / unit string / lit anchors (Bemis-Murcko 1996, Peter 2019 SPF) claim to measure carries no information. The value is a modulo-partitioned GLOBAL Tanimoto distance, not a local sub-pocket one.
defect_1_uniform_placeholder_weights.is_it_just_zero: NO - misattribution, not a silently-zero metric. MEASURED on 3 triazole SMILES (K=4, radius=2, n_bits=2048): per-residue 0.823502886 / 0.919871795 / 0.522222222 vs plain global Tanimoto distance 0.833333333 / 0.914893617 / 0.512820513 (deltas -0.0098 / +0.0050 / +0.0094). The sparse-bin re-weighting is real; only the sub-pocket attribution is wrong.

defect_1b_cited_weight_source_does_not_e.cited_by: docstrings of metric_subpocket_diversity_mean in both impls
defect_1b_cited_weight_source_does_not_e.voxelization_py_255: origin = center - half_extent  (voxel-grid origin, not a residue weight)
defect_1b_cited_weight_source_does_not_e.conclusion: 2 of 3 cited 'real weight source' lines are blank; the 3rd is unrelated. The deferred source does not exist.

defect_2_zero_between_cell_variance.conclusion: All 7+ pool-derived metrics are byte-identical across all 30 (pocket, seed) cells. The sweep carries ONE diversity measurement repeated 30x, not 30 independent ones - the same pathology Wf-R43 m2 just closed for the R2 cohorts. 0.653873 with std 0.0 must NOT be quoted as a reproducible across-pocket result.

honest_framing_note_wf_r43_m7: Wf-R43 m7 (2026-10-08): this metric was DESIGN_ONLY with a unit-test fixture as its only 'measurement'. Reviewing it against disk found two unfalsifiable defects now guarded fail-loud by p3_wf_r43_m7_subpocket_uniform (opt-in WF43_M7_SUBPOCKET_UNIFORM=1, verified FAIL on disk): (1) both live metric implementations build the per-residue weight vector as the uniform placeholder [1]*n_residues, so the sub-pocket axis carries no information, and the 'real weight source' their docstrings defer to does not exist (2 of 3 cited lines blank); (2) the only 30-cell div_subpocket sweep has ZERO between-cell variance (n_unique=1), so it is one measurement replicated 30x. The metric stays DESIGN_ONLY - it is NOT lifted to MEASURED by this wave, because no non-uniform-weighted, multi-cell measurement exists. Nothing was retrained and no GPU was launched.
